headline: Nigeria Reports 3.33 Million Barrels of Crude Oil Theft in 2025
summary: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission reported that 3.33 million barrels of crude oil were stolen in 2025. Approximately 66% of the total theft occurred during the fourth quarter.
why: Nigeria is a major oil producer, and theft significantly impacts government revenue and the operational efficiency of international and domestic oil companies operating in the Niger Delta.
why_moved: Oil theft reduces the net export volume for Nigeria, impacting national revenue and potentially tightening supply for companies operating in the region.
